meta.title: Catalytic Unlock: a nature-at-the-centre, commons-first landscape read
meta.note: This is a sense-making STRATEGY layer, not fetched data. Districts are grouped into six nature/commons landscapes; each carries a catalytic tier and a leverage read computed from the real DMF, CSR and partner-capacity fields. The tiers, nature-weights, theses and the top-10 projects are an editorial design proposal (indicative), built ON TOP of the real money/capacity data to show where small, risk-tolerant catalytic capital can unblock much larger committed public+private pools. Project ₹ figures are illustrative catalytic sizing, not committed pipelines.
meta.framing: Catalytic capital is tiny next to ~₹1,575 Cr/yr of CSR and ~₹27,000 Cr of DMF. Its job is not to add money but to unblock money already committed but not converting, with nature and the commons as the organising unit (forests, water, coasts, mine-land, agrobiodiversity) rather than the administrative district.

convert.label: Convert
convert.strategy: Redirect money-rich, capacity-thin mining districts (DMF+CSR) into mine-land, forest and water-commons restoration.

seed.label: Seed
seed.strategy: Nature-rich, money-poor tribal highlands and thin districts: seed commons, NTFP, millet and springs regeneration; crowd CSR in from outside the plant-gate.

protect.label: Protect
protect.strategy: Coastal and wetland commons under pressure: protect mangrove, lagoon and estuarine-fisheries commons as living cyclone infrastructure.

crowdin.label: Crowd-in
crowdin.strategy: Capital/urban region with money present: crowd corporate CSR into peri-urban nature and river commons to close the urbanisation-with-nature gap.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.strategy: Steady forest and agrobiodiversity mosaics: hold and deepen the anchor landscape, protect what works.

landscapes.name: Central Mining & Brahmani Belt
landscapes.nature: Coal, aluminium and iron country: degraded forest, mine-spoil and overburden, stressed water tables along the Brahmani.
landscapes.thesis: Odisha's money mountain: ~₹25,850 Cr DMF + ~₹1,952 Cr CSR against only ~19 partners. The bottleneck is absorptive capacity, not money. Highest ₹-mobilised-per-₹ of catalytic capital anywhere in the state.

landscapes.name: Eastern Ghats Adivasi Highlands
landscapes.nature: Eastern Ghats hill-and-valley: the Jeypore tract's global rice & millet diversity, springs, shifting-cultivation mosaics, dense NTFP.
landscapes.thesis: Nature-rich and capacity-present (48 partners) but money-poor (tiny DMF, only ~15% of tagged CSR). The place to redistribute and blend CSR + Odisha Millet Mission + FPO + Gates ADAPT around a commons/agrobiodiversity core.

landscapes.name: Mahanadi Delta & Mangrove Coast
landscapes.nature: Bhitarkanika mangroves, the Mahanadi delta and a cyclone-exposed coast; estuarine fisheries and blue-carbon stores.
landscapes.thesis: Carries real money (₹2,760 Cr DMF via Jajapur + ₹499 Cr CSR) but only ~13 partners on a climate-frontline coast. Protect the mangrove-fisher commons as living cyclone infrastructure and unlock blue-carbon finance.

landscapes.name: Chilika & South-Central Catchment
landscapes.nature: Chilika, Asia's largest brackish lagoon (Irrawaddy dolphin, migratory birds), the capital region and the lower Mahanadi/Daya/Kathajodi.
landscapes.thesis: Where the capital region's CSR money (₹733 Cr) and 27 partners sit next to a lagoon and rivers. Crowd corporate CSR into peri-urban nature to answer the 17%-to-40% urbanisation target WITH nature, not against it.

landscapes.name: Western Tableland (KBK / Hirakud)
landscapes.nature: Drought-prone tableland and the upper Mahanadi/Hirakud command: tanks, forest-farm mosaics, distress-migration country (KBK).
landscapes.thesis: Money-poor (₹32 Cr DMF, ₹247 Cr CSR) and thinly served (15 partners), with Boudh & Sonepur near-zero on everything. Seed water-commons revival and MGNREGA convergence to hold people and land against distress migration.

landscapes.name: Similipal & Mayurbhanj
landscapes.nature: The Similipal biosphere reserve: sal forests, an elephant and tiger landscape, dense kendu and mahua NTFP, adivasi commons.
landscapes.thesis: A standalone biosphere anchor with 6 partners but modest money. Anchor and deepen: NTFP value, corridor protection and community forest rights as the template for the northern sal belt.

Anugul.note: Coal/aluminium; huge CSR surge (₹1→392 Cr) + ₹1,926 Cr DMF, 3 partners. Mine-land & Brahmani water restoration.

Kendujhar.note: ₹14,248 Cr DMF (state's largest) + ₹358 Cr CSR, 3 partners. Iron-ore overburden & sal-forest restoration.

Sundargarh.note: ₹9,209 Cr DMF + ₹265 Cr CSR, 6 partners. Mine-land + tribal forest commons.

Jharsuguda.note: ₹653 Cr CSR (2nd highest) + ₹466 Cr DMF, 2 partners. Coal-belt water & land commons.

Jajapur.note: ₹2,752 Cr DMF (chromite/steel) + ₹146 Cr CSR, 2 partners. Delta-edge water & land.

Deogarh.note: Forested, low money (5 partners). Bridge mining-belt restoration into the northern forest.

Koraput.note: Jeypore tract agrobiodiversity, 11 partners. Millet & seed commons core.

Rayagada.note: Niyamgiri/Dongria commons, 10 partners. Springs, NTFP, land rights.

Kandhamal.note: Turmeric & forest commons, 8 partners. NTFP value + FRA.

Nabarangpur.note: Aspirational, thin money, 4 partners. Millets & tanks.

Malkangiri.note: Remote, forest & water commons, 3 partners. Springs + NTFP.

Gajapati.note: Eastern Ghats forest, 2 partners. NTFP + shifting-cultivation transition.

Balangir.note: KBK, distress migration, 3 partners. Water commons + livelihoods.

Bargarh.note: Hirakud command; paddy monoculture, 2 partners. Diversify + water.

Nuapada.note: Aspirational, near-zero money, 4 partners. Tanks + forest-farm.

Boudh.note: Near-zero on everything (₹2.2 Cr CSR, 1 partner). First-mover whitespace.

Sonepur.note: Lowest CSR in state (₹1.4 Cr), 1 partner. First-mover whitespace.

Kendrapara.note: Bhitarkanika mangroves, 3 partners. Blue carbon + fisher commons.

Baleshwar.note: Chandipur coast, 2 partners. Shore & fisheries commons.

Puri.note: Chilika edge + coast, 7 partners. Lagoon fisheries + dunes.

Ganjam.note: Chilika south + Rushikulya, 7 partners. Olive-ridley & lagoon.

Khordha.note: Capital region, most partners (9) + ₹559 Cr CSR. Urban wetlands & city forests.

Nayagarh.note: Forested, elephant, low money (4 partners). Community-forest + river.

Mayurbhanj.note: Similipal biosphere, 6 partners. NTFP + corridor + CFR anchor.

Sambalpur.note: Hirakud + forest, 2 partners. Reservoir fisheries + forest mosaic.

Dhenkanal.note: Forest-farm central, 2 partners. Agrobiodiversity + elephant edges.

projects.name: Mine-Land to Commons Restoration Fund
projects.unlock: Convert mining money (DMF+CSR) to nature/commons restoration
projects.instrument: DMF + CSR blended first-loss pool + community forest management + mine-spoil ecological restoration
projects.mobilises: Steers ₹200+ Cr of DMF/CSR already committed in these districts

projects.name: Eastern Ghats Millet & Agrobiodiversity Commons
projects.unlock: Redistribute CSR to the aspirational highlands + blend agri schemes to productivity
projects.instrument: Catalytic grant + Odisha Millet Mission + FPO match + Gates ADAPT; seed-commons & custodian-farmer network
projects.mobilises: Blends with OMM + FPO + scheme money already flowing to the highlands

projects.name: Bhitarkanika-Mahanadi Mangrove & Fisher Shield
projects.instrument: CSR + blue-carbon finance + community-managed fisheries + mangrove restoration
projects.mobilises: Unlocks carbon finance + cyclone-resilience CSR on a climate-frontline coast

projects.name: Chilika Lagoon Commons & Dolphin-Fisher Livelihoods
projects.instrument: CSR + Chilika Development Authority convergence + fisher cooperatives + ecotourism revenue-share
projects.mobilises: Aligns capital-region CSR with lagoon governance & fisher incomes

projects.name: Similipal Elephant Corridor & Sal-Forest NTFP
projects.unlock: Activate the anchor landscape + redistribute to tribal districts
projects.instrument: CSR + FRA/CFR titling + eco-development committees + NTFP value-addition (mahua, kendu, siali)
projects.mobilises: Anchors corridor protection + NTFP enterprise across the northern sal belt

projects.name: Western Odisha Water-Commons & Tank Revival (KBK)
projects.instrument: Catalytic grant + MGNREGA convergence + watershed + spring-shed & tank restoration
projects.mobilises: Converges MGNREGA + watershed funds against distress migration

projects.name: Community Forest Rights (FRA/CFR) Acceleration Cell
projects.unlock: Open the enabling layer for community control of forest commons
projects.instrument: Catalytic legal-tech + FRA/CFR titling drive + satellite monitoring + community forest MEL
projects.mobilises: Unlocks community governance over 1,000s of Cr of forest commons value; enabling layer for projects 2, 5, 6

projects.name: Odisha Nature-Commons Intelligence Layer
projects.instrument: Fund an open, offline dashboard (this tool) + district CSR/DMF, forest cover, FRA & commons data as a public good
projects.mobilises: Raises allocative efficiency of ~₹1,575 Cr/yr CSR + ~₹27,000 Cr DMF by letting all funders target the weakest districts/pillars

projects.name: Peri-Urban Nature & River Commons (Bhubaneswar-Cuttack-Puri)
projects.unlock: Fill the near-zero philanthropic presence on urbanisation (the Lagging pillar), with nature
projects.instrument: Crowd-in capital-region corporate CSR into urban wetlands, city forests and the Daya/Kathajodi river commons
projects.mobilises: Directs the capital region's ₹700+ Cr CSR toward nature-based urban infrastructure

projects.name: Distributed Solar on Degraded Commons + FPO Cold-Chain
projects.unlock: Blend agri productivity + convert idle/degraded commons to clean-energy value
projects.instrument: Agrivoltaics / community solar on wasteland & grazing commons + FPO cold-chain, DMF+CSR blend
projects.mobilises: Turns degraded commons into community-owned energy + farm-income assets
